name: switch
title: Switch
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Switch, 44 × 24 px. Off: paper track and ink thumb. On: ink track and paper thumb. Hover thickens the line, disabled is dashed, aria-invalid uses the accent colour. The thumb travels in three steps with a trail of speed lines; a small spark flies off when it turns on.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/switch". It wraps your own components/ui/switch, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Paper track and ink thumb when off, the negative when on.

props.name: data-manga
props.description: Set on the root: the hook the track, the thumb and the motion are styled from.
